messages:
Rosa (CS): quick flag from onboarding with HarborHealth. Heard same 3 asks across finance, security, and mobile eng teams. tagging @Eli @Marco

Eli (Product): can you paste the asks + any customer wording? helps with triage.

Rosa (CS): sure 1) In-console per-route/per-environment cost lines (today only exports) 1 impact: procurement needs line items for chargebacks;
2) Ability to pin/disable model variants per endpoint/team for PHI flows;
3) Mobile streaming: better resume/retry semantics on flaky networks.

Marco (PM): quick priors: 3 is high ROI reliability work (target next sprint), 1 is medium backend + UI, 2 is larger (RBAC + audit) and needs security/legal.

June (AE): renewal is 2025-07-12. HarborHealth said procurement will delay approval without visible per-route cost.

Rosa (CS): pasted CSV snippet from call notes for quotes:

Rosa (CS): ```
customer,ask,impact,quote
HarborHealth,per_route_cost,procurement needs line items,"We can't allocate budget without per-route breakdown"
HarborHealth,variant_pinning,security must control models,"We must prevent unvetted variants on PHI endpoints"
HarborHealth,mobile_resume,devs need reconnect,"On weak LTE the stream restarts and loses context"
```

triage-bot: Auto-summary created and tagged: [cost_visibility, variant_control, mobile_reconnect]. Linked PROD-Triage-1055.

Marco (PM): I'll open PROD-Triage-1055 and suggest priorities: mobile_resume -> P1, per_route_cost -> P2, variant_pinning -> P3. will add estimates after scoping.

Eli (Product): add to roadmap sync; if we include per-route visibility ask for a short customer brief and invoice sample.

Rosa (CS): action items: Rosa gather invoice sample + quotes, Marco open ticket and assign, Eli review for legal/security. looping back with artifacts. :thumbsup:
